name: set operations
set add discard in
code:
s = {1}
s.add(2)
s.discard(1)
print(s, 2 in s, 5 in s)

name: list sort key reverse
code:
w = ["bb", "a", "ccc"]
print(sorted(w, key=len), sorted(w, reverse=True))
nums = [3, 1, 2]
nums.sort()
print(nums)

name: list comprehension with if
code: print([x * x for x in range(6) if x % 2 == 0])

name: nested comprehension
code: print([[y for y in range(x)] for x in range(3)])

name: dict comprehension
code: print({k: k * 2 for k in range(3)})

name: map filter lambda
code: print(list(map(lambda x: x + 1, [1, 2])), list(filter(lambda x: x > 1, [1, 2, 3])))
